fusions.name: Belly Flop
fusions.desc: Drops your whole weight on the ground, dealing 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Spent Reserves
fusions.desc: A swipe that spends your own reserves: it costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 9 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Torpor
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Fat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and your armour by 5%.
